judiciary_constitutionalchallenge.any_in: Noma yimuphi umhlali angaphikisa umthetho ovimba amalungelo abo ngokungabi namiyalo. Lapho inkantolo ithola ukungqubuzana, kuvuleka izindlela ezintathu zokuxazulula: isishayamthetho silungisa, isishayamthetho sichitha ukuvimba ngeningi elikhethekile phakathi nesikhathi sokuvimba, noma —Uma isikhathi siphela ngaphandle kwalokhu — ubulungiswa bulungisa umthetho ngokuqondile. Okutholwe yinkantolo, isixazululo esincomo, isikhathi esifanele sokusebenza, nesikhathi sokuchitha ukuvimba — konke kukala ngesikhathi somphakathi.
Noma yimuphi umhlali angafayila; akukho mgcini wenggenge ngaphandle kokuhambisana nendawo yegunya — ilungelo linqobo futhi alikho ikhofu (Art. IV §5.1 · Art. I).
